steps.content: Clutching the ticket Corso gave you, you find your seat in the front row. In the fighting area below, Corso and Angus are facing each other, waiting for the fight to begin.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: Remember all those times when I kicked your ass in this very arena? It makes my heart sing just thinking about it. Hahaha...
Angus looks down at Corso, contempt writ large on his face.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: I'm gonna show you what a true Syndican fighter is like.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Yeah, yeah, whatever.
Corso picks her ears with her finger, looking bored. When she's done with that, she starts flexing her wrists.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Jabber, jabber, jabber... Talk all you want while you still can.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: What did you say?
The referee announces the commencement of the match. Angus comes at Corso with his poleaxe raised.

Corso makes a pretense of deflecting the coming blow and jumps out of the way at the last second. The momentum carries Angus forward, and with a loud clank, his poleaxe smashes into the floor, which cracks.
Frustrated and furious, Angus picks up the poleaxe, ready to mount another attack. But before he can straighten all the way up, Corso sneaks up on him and hits his head with a wooden plank.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: Ow!!!

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Hey, what's wrong with your back, you bent old man?

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: Ahhhhhh...
Driven over the edge, Angus grabs behind him, catches hold of Corso, and sends her flying. He is the current No.1 fighter, not someone to trifle with.
At first, neither fighter seems to have the upper hand. But as the match progresses, Angus shows signs of fatigue. Corso's dexterity and sneak attacks are proving too much for him to handle.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: You sly little monkey, stop running and fight me, if you dare!

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Tired already, huh? How about I let you catch your breath for a minute?
With that, Corso comes to a halt, and stands on the spot with her arms folded in front of her.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: You, you, you... you little ****!!

Howling, Angus throws himself at Corso. When he is about to reach her, Corso leaps into the air, and jumps over Angus using his shoulders as a springboard. She hits his head again with the glue-covered plank.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: My hair! My hair!

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: What the **** did you put on the goddamn plank?!
The plank is glued to Angus's hair. Corso pulls at it, twisting Angus's face out of shape. He is in so much pain that he drops his weapon.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Oops, sorry. That's glue. I didn't clean it up properly.
Corso smiles widely, not loosening her grip on the plank.
Corso throws Angus to the floor and presses a knee hard against one of his weak spots. Angus, hair glued to a wooden plank and lying pinned to the floor, has never felt so humiliated.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Are you gonna admit defeat or what, tough guy?
Angus's eyes are wide and red; his chest is rising and falling rapidly. Unexpectedly, he grabs something hidden behind the small of his back and throws them at Corso.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: Not in a million years!
The flying knives catch the light, gleaming maliciously. Corso had sensed that something was amiss, and had jumped out of the way, but one of the knives still grazed her cheek.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Knives?
Corso touches the cut and bursts out laughing.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Hahaha... Angus, I didn't know you played dirty too.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: You were all high and mighty a moment ago. You should take a look at yourself now. Can't believe you had the gall to call me a dirty fighter.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: I can't lose, you piece of crap!
Angus brushes his ragged hair back with his hand, and realizing what has happened to his hair, he starts raving and stamping.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: I'm the No.1 fighter. Whatever way I choose to fight, I'll still be a ******* better fighter than you!

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: Who do you think you are, you skinny little thing? I can crush you like a bug. How dare you question my strength, you piece of ****?

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: You're babbling. Hahaha...
Corso laughs harder. She sticks out her tongue, an open act of provocation.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: You were done for, the moment you threw those knives at me.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Because by doing that, you admitted that you can't defeat me with physical strength alone.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: Shut up! I've crushed you many times over. You, on the other hand, have never won a match against me.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: You little **** used to be a punchbag in this arena, a sitting duck, fair game for everybody! Just because you can win a game or two now, doesn't mean your little tricks can win you our respect. Wake up!

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: I'm gonna beat you at your own game. I'm gonna make mincemeat of you.
In the face of this new round of taunting from Angus, Corso gives as good as she takes.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: You're so full of crap. That tiny brain of yours, you could have ten more, and you still wouldn't be able to come up with one useful trick to "crush" me, as you put it.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: As someone with more experience in this area, I don't mind teaching you a thing or two, so that you'll know how much inferior you are to a... weapons master!
A clanking exchange of throwing weapons ensures.
Just as Corso predicted, Angus, who is less resourceful when it comes to playing tricks, soon has a hard time keeping up with Corso.
By comparison, Corso deflects each oncoming weapon with ease. She already has the match in the bag, you're confident.

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: Corso! Corso! Corso!
The crowd cheers Corso and chants her name. Listening to the hysterical shouting, you finally understand why so many fighters are obsessed with their pursuit of victory.
If it's a thrilling experience to simply watch from afar as a spectator, it must be an intoxicating one to be actually in the heat of it as a winner.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: A hoarder, aren't you? Come on, show me everything you've got!

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: I'll show you all right!
Angus looks daggers at Corso. Huffing and puffing, he smashes his poleaxe down on the floor three times.
The back door swings open. A group of fighters armed to the teeth streams out. They surround Corso.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Angus, you called in backup? This is against the rules.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: Against the rules? I don't think so. They're just... my weapons.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: I'm not breaking any rules here. You can ask the referee, if you like.
Angus looks confident, convinced that he is in the right. The referee nods assent and lets the fight continue.
The crowd watches this dramatic turn of events unfold and starts talking among themselves. A short moment later, the crowd erupts.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: See? They all agree with me.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: Everybody, are you ready to extend "hospitality" to our old friend Mad Dog?
Angus raises his hand and brings it down, and the fighters, each wearing a menacing grin, close in on Corso. You then hear the two spectators next to you talk in astonishment.

steps.speaker: Spectator A
steps.content: I can't believe that Angus has brought all the old fighters here to help him!

steps.speaker: Spectator B
steps.content: He sure has. This is gonna be good!
Corso knows she is in a bind, but she keeps her cool, even smiling at her enemies.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Old friends, I see. What brings you here? Want to get your asses kicked again?
One of the fighters produces a thick iron chain, clanking in his hands. He is attempting to wrap it around Corso's neck.

steps.speaker: Fighter A
steps.content: You're a nobody. You're not a real fighter, just some errand girl from a weapons factory.
Another of the fighters comes closer. He is attempting to tackle Corso to the floor from the side.

steps.speaker: Fighter B
steps.content: I'm gonna send you flying!
Corso quickly ducks out of the way, and the two fighters smash into each other.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Oh my, you guys are as dumb as ever.
The fighters keep up their onslaught on Corso, employing a wide variety of weapons.

steps.speaker: Fighter C
steps.content: Stop throwing those spiked balls willy-nilly, you dumbass. We're running low!

steps.speaker: Fighter D
steps.content: She's coming your way. Use the Molotov cocktails, quick!

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Hahaha, idiots... Even sloths are more agile than you.
Corso moves around swiftly, dodging attacks with ease, and remains mostly unharmed. So far, she hasn't mounted a single counterattack.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: Morons, can't you see she's making a fool of you? There are many of you, and there is only one of her. Hasn't it occurred to you to corner her?
You're getting anxious, for you know that Corso is not counter-attacking, not because she is toying with her enemies, but because of the restraint you've put on her through the shackles.

steps.speaker: Fighter B
steps.content: Ahhhhhh...
One of the fighters produces a Mania weapon from God knows where and opens fire on Corso.
The others follow suit. They form a tighter and tighter circle around Corso. This is not a fighting contest anymore, but a hunt.
The situation is spinning out of control. It's more than you can handle alone, so you contact the FAC for backup. Now you and Corso have to tough it out until help arrives.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: Nowhere to run, I see.
Corso is concerned, her back against the wall. Angus is standing behind his lackeys, mocking her.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: You and I go back a long way, Corso. I don't want to make this ugly.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: I'll cut you a deal. You go down on your knees and beg for mercy, and I'll ask them to spare you. What do you think? I'm doing this out of the kindness of my heart. Hahaha...
Corso laughs out loud. There's a fierce look in her eyes now. She stops laughing and spits on the floor.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Over my dead body! I'll never admit defeat, ever!

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: Then you leave me no choice. Take her down!

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: Angus! Angus! Angus!
The crowd, who was chanting Corso's name only a minute ago, is now chanting Angus's name.
You feel an overwhelming urge to help Corso. You don't want to see the victory that's rightly hers snatched from her.
You jump over the rail of the grandstand and land between Corso and her enemies.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: Who the **** are you? Get the hell out of here. Don't meddle in what doesn't concern you.
I beg to differ. It does concern me.
You stand up, dust yourself down, and walk over to stand beside Corso. Matter-of-factly, you start explaining.
Like your men here, I'm also a weapon, Corso's weapon.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: You, a weapon?
Angus looks you up and down.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: You're all skin and bones. You wouldn't make a half-decent side dish. Get your ass out of here! Or you'll get a good beating too.
Corso tilts her head to the side and looks at you in puzzlement.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, you're gonna give orders again, aren't you?
You want to win, right, Corso?

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Isn't that obvious?
Good.
You nod and put your hand on her shoulder.
Here is my order: Do Not Lose!
Beams of red light burst out from your palm. In your mind's eye, you see a vicious, teeth-baring dog being unleashed.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: W-what kind of weapon is that? A new type of flash bang? Stop your stupid gimmick!

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Hahahaha!
Corso starts laughing heartily. She steps forward to stand in front of you, and points the business end of her nail-studded plank at Angus's head.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Great. I like it. I like this new order very much!

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: I'm gonna win this. Just wait and see!
Slowly, Corso moves forward. The fighters, intimidated by her overpowering aura, step backward.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: What are you afraid of? It's just her and a burden. Don't be a bunch of chickens!
The fighters come charging at Corso, howling. She is unfazed and even bends forward to pick up a few pieces of scrape from the floor.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Tsk tsk, what a waste! Good raw materials, but the craftsmanship leaves much to be desired.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Um, I guess I'll have to make the best of it. Use the trash to take out this bunch of trash... that's an idea.
Corso scoops up a couple of round stones with her plank and sends them flying. They penetrate the kneecaps of the fighter at the front.

steps.speaker: Fighter A
steps.content: Ahhhhhhhhhh!!!

Then she picks up the iron chain from the floor and flings it. It wraps itself around the ankles of one of the fighters and those of another, and the momentum sends them flying through the air for a long distance.

steps.speaker: Fighter B&C
steps.content: Ahhhhhh!!
A few other fighters come near Corso, but before they can lay a finger on her, they are flung to the floor, where they convulse and pass out.
The rest of the fighters are too afraid to charge now. They start shooting at her with their Mania weapons, and Corso has to block the volley of shots.
Right at this moment, Angus comes howling out of nowhere, his poleaxe raised, and makes to hack at Corso.
Clank, clank, clank... The sound of steel on steel ends with a dull thud of something heavy hitting the floor.
Angus takes an astonished look at his poleaxe without its head and falls onto the floor.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: W-what are you?
Corso gets a small cramp in the hand from holding the nail-studded plank too tightly. She pays no heed to it, only sneers at Angus. The floor is strewed with the carcasses of weapons.
Weapon in hand, she advances on Angus, who scrambles backward. His face now contorts with fear, devoid of arrogance and haughtiness.
For all he knows, Corso could be a wily demon disguised as a skinny girl who is ready to show her true colors and tear him into ribbons.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: Stop! Don't get any closer!!
He wraps his arms around his head, anticipating a deadly onslaught. But to his surprise, he only receives a couple of kicks here and there.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Argh, I didn't know you were such a wuss.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Hey, are you listening?

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: Huh?

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Are you gonna admit defeat or not?
Angus nods his head so rapidly.

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: Yes, yes... You won. I lost!

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Say it. Say I'm the ultimate winner in this arena!

steps.speaker: Angus
steps.content: Y-you are the ultimate winner in this arena!
The crowd erupts, applauding and cheering the new Queen of the Arena. The winner does not address the crowd; instead, she waves at you and runs toward you with a proud look on her face.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Hey, ${PlayerName}, did you hear that? I won!
I did. Congratulations, Queen of the Arena.
The FAC has arrived at the scene to sort out the mess. You leave with the Sinner, heading back to the MBCC.
Corso obediently follows you into the vehicle. Once inside, she keeps a steady gaze on you. The gaze is not malicious, but it makes you uncomfortable nonetheless.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, what made you lift the restraint on me? What changed your mind?

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Wouldn't it be easier for you to bring me back to the MBCC if I had been beaten half to death?
You breathe a sigh of relief now that she's started talking, instead of staring at you.
I'm not some sadistic warden. I don't find locking people up particularly enjoyable.
Besides, I bet on you to win the fight.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Ah, you won the bet. I won!
But I don't think beating people like Angus is much of a challenge for you.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Then what is?
Helping the MBCC solve the Mania crisis. It's much more exciting than beating up those fighters. Wouldn't you agree?
Now that you've conquered the arena, I dare you to fight the Mania crisis alongside the MBCC.
Corso's eyes brighten up as she listens to you. She's happy with what you've just suggested.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Hahaha... I don't scare easily, as you must have known. Fighting the Mania crisis sounds like a good idea.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: If I've got to stay somewhere, I might as well stay by your side.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: I can help you with my power and bring you victory, just like what I did today.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: But you must not forget what you promised me. Assign me the most dangerous, exciting tasks.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: If you go back on your word, you'll be bitten by the most vicious dog.
I won't disappoint you. You have my word.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Okay. I hope you're as good as your word.
